name: A Comprehensive Real-World Dataset of Jackfruit Leaf Diseases and Growth Stages for Intelligent Crop Health Monitoring
description: This study presents a high-quality dataset of jackfruit (Artocarpus heterophyllus) leaf images collected using smartphone cameras from agricultural areas in Savar and Rajbari, Bangladesh. The dataset comprises 1,026 original images distributed across eight classes: Blight, Dried, Fungal Spot, Healthy, Leaf Miner, Pest Damage, Senescence, and Young. The original dataset was partitioned into training (70%), validation (15%), and testing (15%) subsets, containing 714, 162, and 150 images, respectively. To mitigate class imbalance and enhance visual diversity, data augmentation techniques, including horizontal flipping, random rotation, random cropping, zooming, and brightness adjustment, were applied exclusively to the training subset, producing 8,000 training images with 1,000 images per class. All images were resized to 512 × 512 pixels and stored in JPG format with RGB color representation. This dataset provides a resource for developing and evaluating machine learning and deep learning models for jackfruit leaf disease classification, leaf growth-stage recognition, and precision agriculture applications.
